name: Look like the cat that swallowed the canary/got the cream

meaning.zh:
“像吃了金丝雀的猫” 或 “像吃了奶油的猫”。

这个短语源于猫捉到或偷吃到金丝雀或奶油后的满足和得意神态，常用于形容一个人做了某件事后非常得意或自信满满，就像猫偷吃到了美味食物一样，这是从视觉上的形象进行的比喻。
meaning.en: This idiom originates from the visual image of a cat that has caught or stolen a canary or cream and looks extremely satisfied or smug. It's often used to describe someone who appears very pleased or confident after doing something, akin to a cat after consuming a delightful treat.

lines.en: He walked in looking like the cat that swallowed the canary after closing the big deal.
lines.zh: 他进来时一副得意洋洋的样子，因为刚刚完成了一笔大交易。

lines.en: When she won the game, she looked like the cat that got the cream.
lines.zh: 她赢了比赛后，脸上满是满足和得意的神色。

lines.en: He had that look like the cat that swallowed the canary when his idea was accepted.
lines.zh: 他的主意被采纳后，他有一种像吃了金丝雀的猫的得意样子。
